title: 象棋得分排行榜
problem_statement_md:
六位选手参加了国际象棋比赛，且他们的分数(列为`losses`)已统计出来。
棋手表**Players**，数据如下：

![](/content/assets/6f324b0c3244239bfb6d.jpeg)

请写一个sql查询，按选手的得分排序(从低到高)，从而得到排行榜。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Sorting Results[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Six players have competed in a chess tournament and their scores have been tallied.
Here is the table of [b]Players[/b]: [img id="4553" width="100%"]  
[b]Sort [/b]the players by losses to derive the leaderboard.
[note]Recall the [b]ORDER BY[/b] keyword.[/note]
hint_md: 回顾一下**ORDER BY**的关键字。

code_templates.solution_code: SELECT * FROM Players ORDER BY losses
code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE Players (
  firstname VARCHAR(128),
  lastname VARCHAR(128),
  losses int 
);
